lxc_c7bdec62d9b4207d.text: First, we look at waking up and breakfast.

lxc_1a903dde1baaed01.text: Next, we follow children to school, through the school day, and to school lunch.

lxc_9778172f8f4b4019.text: Then we look at after school, bedtime and weekends.

lxc_bbb2917131733764.text: At each step, ask one question: who plans this part of the day?

lxc_f97f86133a801c53.text: It is early morning in an American home.

lxc_e094018b11a3bbdb.text: A boy has little time before school.

lxc_a03a5685786c654b.text: He puts cereal in a bowl and adds milk.

lxc_d637867febe1f4b4.text: He does not cook, so it is fast.

lxc_74458e5a9086ec0c.text: It is common in Western countries.

lxc_e915cc041e27f27b.text: People have eaten it since the late 19th century.

lxc_8cbe28b331c781d7.text: It often has bright colors and cartoons.

lxc_82eb66df8bd1bf4e.text: Companies often sell cereal to children, not only to parents.

lxc_e60f6a8cca94869e.text: So the child helps choose breakfast.

lxc_107ae85199bdab42.text: A company helps shape that choice.

lxc_6560f7173285c79d.text: People who eat breakfast cereal regularly have lower risks of obesity and diabetes.

lxc_cdacfe0c63d824f5.text: So a fast breakfast can still be a good habit.

lxc_ab3d8b3d046e22a7.text: A busy morning and a healthy morning can go together.

lxc_2d6f84cd0d1845e1.text: Picture a street in the morning.

lxc_29df9e337d1695af.text: This is the American school bus.

lxc_6e0bd5d5ec6eb111.text: In the USA, yellow school buses carry students to school and home again.

lxc_7d103673849d81a9.text: They also carry students to school trips and events.

lxc_ec469dce0402ffbb.text: The bus has special safety parts.

lxc_81c5920ab3fce730.text: Warning lights tell other cars to stop.

lxc_93ce61083b8a220e.text: An alarm helps the driver check for children.

lxc_28be5bd618c41f52.text: No child must stay on the bus alone.

lxc_144c31272446aef2.text: Cameras catch cars that pass the bus in a bad way.

lxc_54ce3ac2d5562132.text: School buses see only about five child deaths each year.

lxc_8002d41bf937d1a6.text: They are over 70 times safer than a car ride to school.

lxc_ef4cab31bcd865e9.text: So parents do not need to drive.

lxc_43ff83accb79f7df.text: The bus is a public system, and it does a family job.

lxc_f45c52cbfaceb99a.text: What schools do children go to?

lxc_62601992666a5860.text: Most US children go to public schools.

lxc_78863810692e0f3e.text: They go to elementary school first, then middle school, then high school.

lxc_5d6876b3e93fb3c5.text: The school day often has a break called recess.

lxc_3978d7a08380146c.text: But some US schools are removing recess.

lxc_dbbe6d118cec0d0e.text: This may be bad for children's health and behavior.

lxc_e4e8052f8311e694.text: So the school system is strong, but it is not the same in every school.

lxc_c8874e6cb5189917.text: At noon, look at two children at one table.

lxc_13ac7e2092c5648f.text: One child opens a bag from home.

lxc_e6c9a67228539652.text: The other child has a tray from the school kitchen.

lxc_ee2ebc8967796904.text: The bag from home often has a PB&J sandwich.

lxc_fae1c5411afd7585.text: PB&J means peanut butter and jelly.

lxc_c1345a91bf22f2ad.text: Often it is white bread and grape jelly.

lxc_8ecc26128a375371.text: It is a famous American comfort food.

lxc_a3e5ed4d48ac73d6.text: Many children eat it at school.

lxc_7bed3ef9c6c82dd2.text: The tray is a school meal.

lxc_fca88554ebdb43d6.text: In the US, some schools give free meals to all students.

lxc_897ee70950a081f6.text: Other schools give free meals only to poor families.

lxc_6592dd674edc0672.text: So two schools can have two different rules.

lxc_057faee4a396d322.text: Free meals do more than fill a stomach.

lxc_6b12b9b9b465e8a0.text: Some places have many families without enough food.

lxc_a99ecfe71cc88f9a.text: In these places, free meals help school discipline.

lxc_a1afdf657f175aed.text: A hungry child cannot learn well.

lxc_eaf2cb90474fb9ed.text: A full child can sit and listen.

lxc_f8f19cab547f1e3d.text: So lunch is part of learning, not only a break from learning.

lxc_f819388b4acd85d5.text: Many parents work later than that.

lxc_18f1643a193d2c1d.text: Many children go to after-school activities.

lxc_87305798245d8658.text: They play sports, make art, or study with a coach or a teacher.

lxc_d83a2a72800f204c.text: An adult watches the children the whole time.

lxc_b8c81e3f787f1233.text: They can stay at work and not worry.

lxc_3a6aa640deb65279.text: They also happen on weekends and in summer.

lxc_22a960ce478a6f45.text: So they fill many gaps, not only one.

lxc_9541acbeab3e48ac.text: The activity is not only fun.

lxc_ceb89b6d1beabbb6.text: It also gives children a safe place with an adult and a good group.

lxc_e02cc2604cf415e5.text: Imagine a young girl named Emma.

lxc_94380131b33bc853.text: She eats dinner with her family.

lxc_411573235bf45489.text: A routine is the same steps every night.

lxc_bd18afd551d0d1ee.text: Emma's parents help her get ready for sleep.

lxc_6073ef4ec43b0f0a.text: Her mother or father reads her a story.

lxc_7f4e8da0af39d382.text: Why do the same steps every night?

lxc_58dcdf05dc706d12.text: The steps tell the child, "Sleep is coming."

lxc_86d0b42a4b3af08d.text: The school runs the bus and lunch.

lxc_b3f027e3c2730525.text: A coach watches the children after school.

lxc_6b892f0d20081d6b.text: But at night, the family leads.

lxc_b361567d6df031a0.text: On Saturday, there is no school bus.

lxc_028762af6a0f7e6c.text: After-school activities also happen on weekends.

lxc_43a1ca8dd2f788b4.text: A child can have a game or a class on Saturday.

lxc_15729086fef35d76.text: An adult watches the children again.

lxc_fd853bd15a9f28c9.text: So the weekend is freer, but it is not empty.

lxc_d2df6044e79906b8.text: It has many of the same parts: a group, a place and an adult.

lxc_3a8cd1751fe67e50.text: A US child's day is not only about family choice.

lxc_7261e5f3b7646443.text: Many parts come from bigger systems.

lxc_4a269f1219c3105e.text: A company makes the breakfast cereal.

lxc_47b90910ca349f56.text: The public school has the bus and the meals.

lxc_c835060f43a42a05.text: Programs watch children after school and on weekends.

lxc_3020f3548811d4cd.text: The family leads bedtime and some free time.

lxc_928b7f957056461d.text: These systems try to keep children safe and fed.

lxc_1458de3ca0f35839.text: They also give parents time to work.
